opportunities.title: UKRI 2026 Small Satellite Missions Sandpit
opportunities.summary: UKRI Space Programme seeks UK researchers to develop small satellite Earth observation missions supporting national security, defence and growth.

opportunities.title: British Industrial Competitiveness Scheme (BICS) applications close
opportunities.summary: BICS applications are open until 30 November. Apply through the GOV.UK service.

opportunities.title: BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for decision-critical systems
opportunities.summary: Innovate UK share of up to £5m for AI SMEs with a TRL 5 to 6 solution, deploying with a medium or large UK organisation.

opportunities.title: UKDI electro-optic sensing competition, £2.8m
opportunities.summary: UK Defence Innovation, for Dstl, seeks electro-optic sensing that improves range, target recognition and performance in hard conditions, maturing TRL 3 to 6. Open to businesses, sole traders and universities.

opportunities.title: Space Florida and UK Space Agency innovation partnership
opportunities.summary: Joint R&D funding of up to £75k per UK partner. Consortia need a Florida partner and a UK business or academic partner.

opportunities.title: Secure Innovation security reviews for technology SMEs
opportunities.summary: NPSA and NCSC security reviews worth £3,000 for a £500 contribution, covering cyber, risk, security culture and supply chain.
